reviews.title: Want to feel connected? Download!
reviews.text:
This app has been amazing. My girlfriend and I were already very connected. We are doing the long distance thing, thankfully not for much longer.  One of the hardest things we have had to deal with is consistently feeling that sense of connection with each other. This app made it incredibly easy. When you have time you go on and it asks you to answer questions about your relationship that your partner will see.  The questions are prompts you would not otherwise ask. When your partner has time they answer and you get to see how they answered. 
If you are serious about your relationship and you put some serious thought and effort into the way you answer these questions, the only thing that’s going to happen is you getting closer to your partner.
10 out of 5 stars!

reviews.title: Flamme app

reviews.title: It’s great

reviews.title: Flame Review

reviews.title: Great App

reviews.title: Our daily show of love

reviews.title: Healthy relationship game
reviews.text:
My boyfriend introduced me to Flamme shortly after we decided to get into a serious relationship, and it felt like a small but meaningful act of love. It showed how much he cared about nurturing what we were building together.

Through interesting and thoughtful questions, Flamme creates a space for deeper  conversations, sexy innuendos, shared laughter, and a safe place f or more vulnerable topics. It has helped us open up about our dreams and fears, deepen our trust, and feel more emotionally connected. What I love most is how it turns connection into something joyful and intimate; a little daily ritual that brings us closer and reminds us why we chose each other in the first place

reviews.title: amazing for connection!

reviews.title: Actually helping our long distance
reviews.text: 3 months apart now and this app helped us more than expected. The couple bucket list makes us plan little things for our next meetup. The couple widgets are a small touch but makes us feel connected somehow. I’ve used long distance relationship apps before and this one just works better.

reviews.title: cute and stress free

Also we made a couple bucket list for this year and it’s honestly motivating us. Way better than the other long distance relationship apps we tried.

reviews.title: big fan now
reviews.text: Just stumbled on Flamme by chance. Didn’t think much. But the couple bucket list is now our fav thing we keep adding stupid stuff like “try 10 new desserts”. The couple widgets look nice too. For LDR, this is one of the few long distance relationship apps that doesn’t feel cringe.

reviews.title: helped us reconnect
reviews.text: We were kinda distant these months. Flamme made it easier to talk again. The daily questions + couple bucket list really helped. And the couple widgets is such a small thing but I love it. If you’re checking long distance relationship apps, start with this one first, seriously.

reviews.title: Great for couples!
reviews.text: In a long relationship, after a while, it becomes very hard to find exciting topics to talk about. Flamme is definitely a great conversation starter for us!

reviews.title: Fantastic customer services and support
reviews.text:
The app itself is intuitive and cute. It certainly provides a couple with the ability to address certain questions that may otherwise lead to discomfort, and it does so in a manner that actually brings a couple much closer while answering said questions. 

It is enjoyable as well, it provides a valuable platform for long distance relationships to develop in an enjoyable and meaningful way.

Beyond this, customer support has proven to be very friendly, helpful, and generous. They demonstrate an eagerness to truly satisfy and please the users of their app. 

This alone, for me personally, warrants a higher rating and respect for this app and its developers. 

Highly recommend it for those interested in a new and enjoyable way to learn about your partner, in addition to growing closer to them.

reviews.title: Don’t get premium
reviews.text: Honestly premium is pointless. They are supposed to update the quizzes weekly and they don’t. My fiance and I have used the app for 2 months and they haven’t been updated once. We did 95% of them in 2 days. Other than that, the app is fantastic and we have continued to use it every day.

reviews.title: This app thinks every couple has issues!
reviews.text: I initially believed that this app was designed to add excitement to my relationship, perhaps by providing suggestions on where to go or offering fun conversation starters. It seemed like a great idea to have on my phone. However, I was disappointed to find that the first question it asked was whether I wanted to work on communication, money, or family. This seemed odd to me, as I have been happily married for 24 years and don't feel the need to work on anything in particular. It would have been nice if the app had additional options, such as "let's try new things" or "fun challenges for couples," to better match its icon and overall vibe. Not everyone is unhappy, and the app could benefit from acknowledging that.

reviews.title: Keeps things fresh and fun!
